matter.note: The node id is zero-padded to 16 hex characters. The compressed fabric id changes if the fabric is re-commissioned, which would orphan every stored device handle, so a Matter handle should key on node id and treat a fabric change the way FR-E21 treats a new Z-Wave home id.

mqtt.note: Zigbee2MQTT devices are mqtt devices and the identifier is prefixed with the base topic. An instance using a different base topic produces different identifiers, so the backend must not hard-code the zigbee2mqtt prefix.

zwave_js.note: Two identifiers per device. The short form is what helpers.get_device_id builds and is the one to match when attaching an entity. The long form comes from get_device_id_ext and additionally pins the fingerprint, so it changes when a node is replaced by a different model, which is exactly the signal FR-S3 uses to detect a swap.

data.registry_schema_note: On Home Assistant 2026.8.3 a device registry record has config_entry_id (singular) and primary_config_entry, not the config_entries list older code expects. It also carries composite_device_id, composite_primary_config_entry, has_composite_identifiers and split_at from the composite-device feature. All sampled devices report has_composite_identifiers false, so composites are not in play here, but code that walks the registry must not assume the old shape.
